title: Alder & Pine Coffee, weekday morning (fictional)
question: If the cafe raises its price, which kinds of customers go across the street or skip coffee?
context: A weekday morning on Maple Street in a fictional college town. Alder & Pine Coffee is an independent cafe. Brewline, a chain coffee shop, is directly across the street.

nodes.name: Alder & Pine Coffee
nodes.about: Independent cafe. Espresso drinks made to order by baristas who know the regulars by name. One register.

nodes.name: Brewline (chain)
nodes.about: Chain coffee shop across the street. Fast and consistent, with mobile ordering. Nothing special.

minds.name: June Hadley
minds.bio: Retired teacher. Her morning walk has ended at Alder & Pine every day for six years, and the baristas start her order when she walks in.
minds.personality: warm, loyal, on a fixed pension
minds.goal: Her usual coffee and a few minutes of conversation
minds.social: tells her walking group about any change

minds.name: Marcus Oyelaran
minds.bio: Runs the print shop two doors down and comes in twice a day.
minds.personality: busy, friendly, believes shop owners on the street should support each other
minds.goal: A quick coffee before opening his own shop
minds.social: talks to the other shop owners on the street

minds.name: Priyanka Desai
minds.bio: Freelance designer who works from the cafe two mornings a week. Money has been tighter since she went freelance.
minds.personality: thoughtful, watches her spending, likes the atmosphere
minds.goal: A coffee and a table to work at

minds.name: Tomas Reyes
minds.bio: Undergraduate on financial aid who counts every dollar. He likes this cafe but it is a treat, not a habit.
minds.personality: careful with money, a little self-conscious about it
minds.goal: A coffee before his nine o'clock class, if it is worth it
minds.social: tells his roommates where the deals are

minds.name: Ellie Park
minds.bio: Meets the same three friends for coffee before class most mornings.
minds.personality: sociable, goes where the group goes
minds.goal: To be wherever her friends are
minds.social: group chat with her friends all morning

minds.name: Dev Malhotra
minds.bio: Graduate student who was in the lab until two in the morning and is due back at eight.

minds.name: Karen Liu
minds.bio: Her train leaves in twelve minutes and the next one is an hour later.
minds.goal: Coffee in hand without missing the train

minds.name: Bill Novak
minds.bio: Has ordered the same coffee at the same place on the way to work for ten years.
minds.personality: a creature of habit who dislikes change and notices it
minds.social: complains to coworkers when something changes

minds.name: Shanice Brown
minds.bio: Nurse on her way home after a twelve-hour night shift.
minds.personality: exhausted, wants one small good thing before bed, no patience for fuss

minds.name: Greta Lindqvist
minds.bio: Visiting town for the day and exploring Maple Street before a meeting.
minds.personality: curious, prefers local places to chains when she travels

minds.name: Omar Farouk
minds.bio: Delivery driver with two minutes between stops.
minds.personality: in a hurry, looks for the cheapest quick option

minds.name: Lucy Chen
minds.bio: Out with a baby in a stroller who has finally fallen asleep.
minds.personality: protective of the nap, avoids crowds and long lines
minds.goal: A coffee without waking the baby
